evidence.quote:
The vapor
trap is open to ambient so as to maintain the chamber at atmospheric pressure during testing.

the pool is filled with 40 ml of
fluorinert liquid FC-72, which has the following thermophysical
properties: Tsat = 56 C

Free particles in the diameter range of 45-53 lm
yield the maximum CHF (161 kW/m2), 44% higher than that of a
polished surface.

It may be
noted here that the CHF reached by this smallest particle size considered is higher than that for the polished surface (112 kW/m2).

The 90-106 lm
particles show the maximum decrease in wall superheat compared
to a polished surface at 72 kW/m2 (20.4 K-1.3 K).

The onset of nucleate boiling
occurs at a higher wall superheat (9.5 K for 90-106 lm particles
compared to 6.8 K for 180-212 lm)

The copper block has a smooth
25.4 25.4 mm top surface exposed to the working fluid.

This procedure results in a mirror-finish surface with roughness RRMS = 20 nm, as measured by a non-contact 3D scanning
white light interferometer
